call_points.text: Total CapEx guidance for FY27 is approximately ₹42,000 crores to support 5 GW RE expansion and 10+ GW-hour BESS capacity.
Q1FY27 EBITDA from power supply grew 33% YoY to ₹4,122 crores with a 94% EBITDA margin.
Energy sales increased 30% YoY to 13.7 billion units, supported by strong weather conditions and a 27% increase in capacity.
Operational capacity reached 20,142 MW with 4,327 MW greenfield addition.
Company plans to maintain its long-term goal of having more than 90% of installed capacity tied up in long-term PPAs.
AGEL plans to add 4.5 to 5.0 GW of solar and wind capacity in FY27, aligned with evacuation availability.

timeline.summary: Adani Green Energy operationalised a 292 MW solar power project at Khavda, Gujarat through its step-down subsidiary, taking total operational renewable capacity to 19,585.8 MW.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,502 Cr (+14.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹397 Cr (+72.6% YoY).

Adani Green Energy Limited shared audio recordings of its Analysts/Investors Call on Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for Q4FY26 and FY26, held on April 24, 2026, via its website.
Adani Green Energy reported FY26 power supply revenue of ₹11,602 Cr and EBITDA of ₹10,865 Cr, backed by a record 5.1 GW greenfield capacity addition.
Adani Green reported FY26 power supply revenue of ₹11,602 Cr (+22% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹10,865 Cr (+23% YoY) backed by a record 5.1 GW greenfield capacity addition.
S.B. Adani Family Trust (via **Pritamkumar Pritamkumar Nenmal Shah**) declared no encumbrances on Adani Green Energy shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Reg 31(4).
Adani Green operationalized a 150 MW solar power project at Khavda, Gujarat, taking total operational capacity to 19,735.8 MW.
Adani Green informed the exchange of a further update on the US matter, where the US SEC and the Adanis have filed a request for a final judgment on consent.
2026-05-18: Adani Green informed exchange of US DOJ motion seeking dismissal with prejudice of charges against its promoters
Adani Green operationalized a 50 MW solar project and 1,990 MWh BESS at Khavda, taking total operational capacity to 19,785.8 MW.
Adani Green Energy commissioned a cumulative 3.37 GWh battery energy storage system at Khavda, Gujarat.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,431 Cr (+16.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹845 Cr (+18.5% YoY).
Adani Green Energy reported Q1FY27 operational and financial highlights, with power supply revenue at ₹4,280 Cr and operational capacity at 20,142 MW.
Adani Green Energy Limited hosted an analysts/investors conference call on unaudited Q1 FY27 results (June 30, 2026) with audio recording available via company website.
Adani Green Energy reported Q1FY27 earnings conference call transcript, highlighting 20 GW operational capacity, ₹4,122 Cr power supply EBITDA, and ₹8,800 Cr quarterly capex.
US District Court entered final consent judgment in SEC civil complaint against Gautam Adani and Sagar Adani, imposing civil penalties.
US District Court dismissed the criminal indictment against Gautam Adani, Sagar Adani, and Vneet S. Jaain with prejudice on August 10, 2026.

Adani Green operationalised a 139 MW solar project at Khavda through step-down subsidiary Adani Green Energy Twenty Six A Limited, taking total operational renewable capacity to 20,280.80 MW and BESS to 3,551 MWh.
Adani Green Energy Limited’s EGM on September 03, 2026, passed re-appointments of Romesh Sobti, Neera Saggi, and Anup Shah as Independent Directors for five-year terms.
Adani Green received a SEBI settlement order on September 22, 2026, involving a ₹45.50 lakh settlement amount for alleged listing regulation violations.
Adani Green operationalised 481.9 MW of renewable energy projects and 3,081 MWh of BESS capacity, raising total operating capacity to 20,762.70 MW and BESS to 6,632 MWh.
Adani Green reported an operational capacity of 20,763 MW and energy sales of 25,747 million units for H1 FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,258 Cr (+41.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹673 Cr (+15.4% YoY).
Adani Green reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹8,299 Cr, up 36% YoY, with operational capacity expanding to 20,763 MW.
